# AI-augmented foundations

> Whether the family's setup is complete and whether it converges: can a tree or graph of topics encode every problem at a cognitive cost a person bears; how fast a project reaches a result, acceptable or optimal, and what an optimum is. The first review is written, in two topics.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [AI-augmented foundations](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/evidence/README.md): the first review in two topics and the bibliography
- [Expressiveness](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/evidence/expressiveness/README.md): what a tree or graph of topics encodes, and its cost to a reader
- [Convergence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/evidence/convergence/README.md): when a project stops, and what an optimum is
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-foundations/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
